text:
Type: fabric storage basket, set of two
Use: storing clothes, toys, blankets on shelves; bedroom, living room, home office
Style: coastal, contemporary
Materials: canvas fabric, lined interior, cotton rope handles
Colors: navy and white stripes, cream, grey lining
Shape: soft rectangular bin with pinstriped upper band and plain lower band, rope loop handles, medium and lightweight
Feel: fresh, casual, tidy
Goes with: white shelving, light wood, navy and white textiles; coastal or contemporary rooms

product.name: AmazonBasics Fabric Storage Basket Container with Rope Handles, Set of 2, Medium
product.description: Medium-size attractive storage basket (2-pack) for neatly storing everyday items Made of non-woven fabric and high-quality cardboard for reliable structure Ideal for a bedroom, playroom, or living room; simple, classic style for easy coordinating Side loop handles for easy carrying or pulling off a shelf; folds for compact storage Measures 15.7 by 11.8 by 8.3 inches each; backed by an AmazonBasics 1-year limited warranty
